### `.env.example`

```bash
# ── Kalshi API credentials (required) ─────────────────────────────────────────
KALSHI_API_KEY_ID=your-kalshi-api-key-id
# Paste your Kalshi EC private key PEM. Keep its header/footer lines and use a
# literal \n between each line; the loader normalizes whitespace and dashes.
KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY=<your-ec-private-key-pem-with-\n-between-lines>

# ── Telegram alerts (required for notifications) ──────────────────────────────
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=<bot-token-from-BotFather>
TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID=<your-chat-id-eg--100xxxxxxxxxx>

# ── Server ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PORT=8000

# ── Database (auto-set by Replit; set manually for local dev) ─────────────────
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://<user>:<password>@<host>:5432/kalshi_monitor

# ── Core Q15 policy (safe defaults shown — all optional) ──────────────────────
Q15_V95_ENABLED=true
Q15_V95_FORCE_ACTIVE=true
Q15_V95_EMERGENCY_DISABLE=false
Q15_V95_PUBLIC_DATA_ENABLED=true
Q15_V95_PUBLIC_REFRESH_SECONDS=5
Q15_V95_PUBLIC_STALE_SECONDS=20

# ── Low-latency spot feed (optional, default OFF) ─────────────────────────────
# Stream the underlying spot over public exchange websockets (Coinbase USD,
# OKX USDT) instead of ~5s REST polling, for faster reaction near settlement.
# Read-only market data: never authenticates, never places an order. If the
# feed is off, disconnected, or a tick is older than the max age below, the
# system transparently falls back to REST + last-good. Verify via /api/health
# ("spot_ws"). Flag OFF = today's exact REST behaviour.
# Q15_SPOT_WS_ENABLED=true
# Q15_SPOT_WS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=3

# ── Fast canonical candle build (optional, default OFF) ───────────────────────
# Behaviour-IDENTICAL speedup of the v9.5 candle build: skips redundant per-row
# alias resolution on the cached history (direct-alias hits only; any row that
# would need the frozen walk falls back to it verbatim). ~1.8x faster on the
# candle build, byte-for-byte the same candles. Frozen v91..v94 chain untouched.
# Locked by tests/test_q15_fast_canonical_candles.py (incl. a randomized fuzz).
# Now default ON; set =false to revert to the exact frozen _canonical_candles.
# Q15_FAST_CANONICAL_CANDLES=false

# Behaviour-identical hot-path caches for the v9.5 ledger reads (Platt
# calibration fit, pattern-similarity centroids, challenger weights) that ran
# per asset per cycle but only change on resolution / weight updates. Default
# ON; set =false to recompute every call. Locked by
# tests/test_q15_v95_ledger_cache.py.
# Q15_V95_LEDGER_CACHE=false

# Per-stage profiler for analyse_v95 (read-only, default OFF). When on, times
# each feature/model/ledger stage and surfaces totals under
# /api/health -> q15_v9_5.feature_profile (ranked by total time) so the next
# optimisation target is data-driven. Judge on avg_ms.
# Q15_V95_PROFILE_FEATURES=true

# Cycle watchdog: flag refresh cycles slower than this many seconds in
# /api/health ("cycle_watchdog"), naming the offending stage (time outside the
# timed stages shows as "unaccounted_seconds"). Diagnostic only. Default 10.
# Q15_CYCLE_WATCHDOG_SECONDS=10

# Watchdog pager: send a Telegram alert when a refresh cycle stalls, so a freeze
# pages you instead of going silent. Fires only above the alert threshold
# (higher than the watchdog log threshold, so only real freezes page), after a
# warmup grace (ignores cold-start cost), at most once per cooldown window.
# Q15_WATCHDOG_ALERT_ENABLED=true
# Q15_WATCHDOG_ALERT_SECONDS=20
# Q15_WATCHDOG_ALERT_WARMUP_SECONDS=60
# Q15_WATCHDOG_ALERT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=600

# Q15_V95_15M_MIN_PROBABILITY=0.58
# Q15_V95_10M_MIN_PROBABILITY=0.60
# Q15_V95_15M_REQUIRED_EDGE_CENTS=4.0
# Q15_V95_10M_REQUIRED_EDGE_CENTS=6.0
# Q15_V95_MIN_DATA_QUALITY=0.55
# Q15_V95_MAX_SPREAD_CENTS=12.0
# Q15_V95_SHADOW_LEARNING=true

# ── Primary learning checkpoint ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# 10M is the primary (heaviest) learner; 15M now also learns by default
# (observational shadow only — champion weights stay frozen). 7M is held OFF
# until the challenger tables' CHECK constraint admits '7M' (schema migration).
# Set a flag to false to opt a checkpoint out.
# Q15_V95_PRIMARY_LEARNING_CHECKPOINT=10M
# Q15_V95_10M_SHADOW_LEARNING=true
# Q15_V95_15M_SHADOW_LEARNING=true
# Q15_V95_7M_SHADOW_LEARNING=false   # needs a '7M' schema migration first

# ── Alert lifecycle: one alert per material verdict, with expiry ──────────────
# The checkpoint alert key embeds the best pick's material state (coin/side/grade)
# so an unchanged verdict is deduplicated and only a real direction- or
# confidence-band change (or an entry appearing/withdrawing) sends a replacement.
# Each interval's alert also auto-expires: 15M at the 10:00 mark, 10M at the 7:00
# mark, and 7M this many seconds before close (default 120) so a 7-minute alert
# does NOT linger until market close. TREND_EPSILON is the confidence move (in
# probability) needed to tag a prediction strengthening/weakening vs stable.
# Q15_V95_7M_EXPIRY_SECONDS=120
# Q15_V95_TREND_EPSILON=0.01

# ── One follow-up check per recommended entry (default ON) ────────────────────
# After an entry is recommended and the alert delivered, arm exactly ONE follow-up
# check for that contract+interval. It fires once, DELAY seconds later, and
# confirms whether the entry is still valid / the side changed, advising hold /
# take-profit / avoid / exit — then never repeats. Tracked per (contract,
# interval) so a 15M follow-up never blocks the same contract's 10M follow-up. No
# entry recommended => no follow-up. Eligible intervals default to 15M and 10M
# (7M is the final short leg). FLIP_RISK_SCORE is the risk level above which the
# verdict suggests taking profit instead of a plain hold.
# Q15_V95_ENTRY_FOLLOWUP_ENABLED=false       # disable the follow-up check entirely
# Q15_V95_FOLLOWUP_DELAY_SECONDS=120         # delay after the entry alert before the one follow-up
# Q15_V95_FOLLOWUP_CHECKPOINTS=15M,10M       # intervals eligible for a follow-up
# Q15_V95_FOLLOWUP_FLIP_RISK_SCORE=70        # flip-risk score that flips HOLD -> take-profit advice

# ── Entry-only delivery (default ON) ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Only message on an actual recommended entry: when nothing qualifies as a BEST
# ENTRY, the checkpoint alert is not sent at all — every "NO ENTRY" checkpoint is
# hard-muted regardless of the alert level below. The full picture stays on the
# dashboard; flip-risk and follow-up alerts are separate and unaffected.
# Q15_V95_SEND_ONLY_ON_ENTRY=false           # restore NO-ENTRY checkpoint messages

# ── Best-entry top/detail consistency (always on) ─────────────────────────────
# The alert's top "🏆 BEST ENTRY" is rank #1 of the qualifying entries from the
# SAME ranking the detailed table renders (executable trade score: conditions
# passed -> conservative net edge -> confidence -> data quality), never an
# independent confidence-only pick. Only an asset with an actual ENTRY RECOMMENDED
# decision is eligible; if none qualify the alert shows NO ENTRY RECOMMENDED. A
# validation guard suppresses the alert if the top summary ever disagrees with
# rank #1 of the detail, so a mismatch can never ship.

# ── 10M setup scan (default ON, read-only, leakage-safe) ──────────────────────
# Searches settled 10M predictions for a combination of decision-time conditions
# that predicts the final outcome, and reports it in the hourly report. Guards are
# enforced, not optional: time-ordered train/test split (discovers on the earlier
# slice, CONFIRMS on a later untouched slice), a minimum-support floor (kills
# over-specific rules), Bonferroni multiple-testing correction (kills "100% on the
# luckiest of thousands tried"), and Wilson lower bounds instead of the raw rate
# (so "100% on 8 cases" is shown as its conservative >=X%). Self-silent until there
# are enough settled rows to discover AND validate. NEVER changes a prediction.
# Q15_SETUP_MINER_ENABLED=false               # turn the scan off
# Q15_SETUP_MINER_MIN_SUPPORT_TRAIN=30        # min occurrences in the train slice
# Q15_SETUP_MINER_MIN_SUPPORT_TEST=10         # min occurrences in the test slice
# Q15_SETUP_MINER_MAX_CONDITIONS=2            # max conjuncts per setup (cap complexity)
# Q15_SETUP_MINER_TRAIN_FRACTION=0.70         # chronological train/test split point
# Q15_SETUP_MINER_MIN_WILSON_LB=0.60          # out-of-sample usefulness gate
# Q15_SETUP_MINER_ALPHA=0.05                  # family-wise error rate (pre-correction)

# ── Entry-economics shadow A/B (default ON, read-only) ────────────────────────
# Runs a stricter, cost-aware entry gate BESIDE the live one and grades both on the
# same settled trades, so you can see whether it would make more money — it NEVER
# changes the live recommendation. The shadow charges the extra real costs the live
# model omits (slippage + adverse selection), enforces a hard no-trade floor, and
# requires a non-negative risk-adjusted EV (net_edge - k*sigma). Shadow P&L is also
# charged those extra cents, so it must earn its selectivity. Surfaced live on the
# snapshot (q15_v9_5_shadow_econ_*) and compared in the hourly report.
# Q15_SHADOW_ECON_ENABLED=false               # turn the A/B off
# Q15_SHADOW_ECON_SLIPPAGE_CENTS=0.5          # extra cost the live model omits
# Q15_SHADOW_ECON_ADVERSE_CENTS=0.25          # adverse-selection cost, omitted live
# Q15_SHADOW_ECON_NO_TRADE_ZONE_CENTS=1.0     # never enter an edge thinner than this
# Q15_SHADOW_ECON_RISK_K=0.04                 # risk penalty per cent of outcome stdev

# ── UI consistency: legacy report layout (default OFF) ────────────────────────
# The old v94 reformatter is disabled by default so every alert/report uses the
# clean UI. Set =true only to restore the legacy fallback formatter.
# Q15_V95_LEGACY_FALLBACK_FORMAT=true

# ── 10-minute learning priority ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# 10M is the primary learner and best performer; its resolved results carry this
# much more sample weight in shadow training than the secondary 7M/15M intervals
# (which keep learning, just slower). Raise to lean harder on 10M. Actual 10M
# predictive performance is validated out-of-sample (/api/q15-v9/out-of-sample)
# and per-interval (/api/q15-v9-5/scoreboard: accuracy, precision/recall for
# Yes & No, FPR/FNR, by-grade, and prediction-stability) — this only changes
# training weight, never the displayed confidence.
# Q15_V95_PRIMARY_LEARNING_WEIGHT=1.25

# ── Regime-aware market anchor (default ON) ───────────────────────────────────
# Scale how far the model may deviate from the (efficient) Kalshi market by how
# trustworthy the regime is: full deviation in clean trends, shrunk toward the
# market in noisy regimes (high volatility, exchange divergence, threshold pin).
# Set Q15_V95_REGIME_AWARE_ANCHOR=false to restore the fixed
# Q15_V95_MARKET_ANCHOR_STRENGTH everywhere. SENSITIVITY scales the shrink per
# unit of regime uncertainty above the 0.08 NORMAL baseline; MIN_FACTOR floors it.
# Q15_V95_REGIME_AWARE_ANCHOR=false
# Q15_V95_REGIME_ANCHOR_SENSITIVITY=3.0
# Q15_V95_REGIME_ANCHOR_MIN_FACTOR=0.40

# ── Evidence-coverage confidence penalty (default ON, 0.08) ───────────────────
# Make "insufficient evidence" read as low confidence instead of a clean neutral
# signal: when few features have data, widen the conservative haircut toward 0.5.
# PENALTY is the max extra haircut at zero coverage (default 0.08; 0.0 = off,
# max 0.20); FLOOR is the per-feature quality counted as "covered".
# Q15_V95_EVIDENCE_COVERAGE_PENALTY=0.08
# Q15_V95_EVIDENCE_COVERAGE_FLOOR=0.40

# ── Promotion screen: minimum effect size (default 0.002 Brier) ───────────────
# The manual-promotion screen runs a paired Brier test. With real float values a
# near-identical, economically trivial improvement has numerically tiny variance,
# so it can read as highly "significant". Require a minimum mean Brier reduction
# before a challenger is flagged as a candidate (observational only — never
# touches live weights). Set to 0.0 to disable; raise to demand a bigger edge.
# Q15_V95_PROMOTION_MIN_EFFECT=0.002

# ── Learning corpus quality floor (default OFF) ───────────────────────────────
# Optionally keep marginal-quality snapshots (e.g. spot from a thin public
# fallback) out of the prediction ledger so calibration trains on cleaner data.
# 0.0 = record everything (current behaviour); raise toward 1.0 to require higher
# data_quality before a prediction is recorded.
# Q15_V95_MIN_RECORD_DATA_QUALITY=0.0

# ── Suspected price-manipulation tracking (default ON) ────────────────────────
# Read-only flag that large players may be pushing the price, composed from the
# engine's existing tells: strike pin, order-wall absorption (most directional —
# also reports which side it may flip toward), and cross-exchange divergence. It
# is recorded per prediction, broken down in the scoreboard (suspected vs clean +
# per tell) and the hourly report, and tagged on the live V9.5 alert. It NEVER
# changes the prediction. MIN_SIGNALS = how many tells must agree to flag (1-3).
# Q15_V95_MANIPULATION_TRACKING=false        # turn the whole feature off
# Q15_V95_MANIPULATION_ALERT_TAG=false       # keep it out of the live Telegram alert
# Q15_V95_MANIPULATION_MIN_SIGNALS=1
# Q15_V95_MANIPULATION_DIVERGENCE_BPS=35
#
# Gated manipulation ALERTS (default ON, but heavily gated). Detection always runs
# in the background; a manipulation alert is only PUSHED to Telegram when ALL of:
#   1. the suspected manipulation has a HIGH estimated probability of occurring
#      (learned flip hit-rate, Wilson lower bound, >= MIN_PROBABILITY);
#   2. the interval's NORMAL/base check was already DELIVERED (not muted/failed) —
#      no manipulation alert is sent before/instead of the normal check;
#   3. the later analysis recommends a DIFFERENT side/entry/exit/action than the
#      normal check did. Unchanged/repetitive/low-confidence findings are dropped;
#      qualifying findings for an interval are COMBINED into one concise alert.
# DEFAULT OFF (changed): on the live official record the delivered manipulation
# alert was directionally WRONG — 23.7% correct over n=59, Wilson CI excludes 50%
# on the low side, i.e. an anti-signal. Detection/tracking still runs for the
# learning record; only the standalone alert DELIVERY is suppressed. Set =true to
# restore it (e.g. after the signal is reworked).
# Q15_V95_MANIPULATION_ALERTS_ENABLED=false
# Q15_V95_MANIPULATION_ALERT_MIN_PROBABILITY=0.70  # high-probability gate (0..1)
# Q15_V95_MANIPULATION_ALERT_MIN_CONFIDENCE=40     # minimum evidence confidence (0..100)

# ── 15M checkpoint alert delivery (default OFF) ───────────────────────────────
# On the live record the 15M checkpoint is a coin flip (~53%, Wilson CI includes
# 50%) and loses money per pick, so its ACTIONABLE alert delivery defaults OFF.
# The 15M prediction is still recorded observationally (learning + the timing
# experiment); only the Telegram panel / official actionable record is
# suppressed. 10M/7M always deliver. Set =true to restore 15M alerts.
# Q15_V95_15M_ALERTS_ENABLED=false

# ── Strict flip-decision engine (observational; default ON for collection) ───
# Per interval, for the #1 pick, decides YES/NO on whether the predicted side
# will GENUINELY flip (settle the opposite way) before close. Flip probability is
# a bounded blend primarily of the (oriented) manipulation score; a YES is
# returned ONLY when the interval's threshold is VALIDATED out-of-sample to the
# target precision AND the probability clears it — otherwise NO (background).
# Every decision is stored before settlement and graded against the official
# result (no temporary move counts as a flip). Thresholds are learned per
# interval from completed POST-RESET history via chronological OOS — never fixed,
# never tuned on the rows they grade. Visible output is only the 3-line FLIP
# CHECK block inside each interval section; all math/validation stay hidden.
# Q15_V95_FLIP_DECISION_ENABLED=true
# Q15_V95_FLIP_TARGET_PRECISION=0.80   # YES-decision precision target (per interval)
# Q15_V95_FLIP_TRAIN_FRACTION=0.70     # chronological train fraction (rest is OOS test)
# Q15_V95_FLIP_MIN_ROWS=60             # min settled decisions/interval before calibrating
# Q15_V95_FLIP_MIN_YES_TRAIN=10        # min YES in train to trust a candidate threshold
# Q15_V95_FLIP_MIN_YES_TEST=10         # min YES in test to declare it validated
# Q15_V95_FLIP_SHOW_POST_RESET_ONLY=true   # reset-status: hide pre-reset results
# Reset the flip dataset (archive + clear active, recalc from new data only) via
# V95Ledger.reset_flip_data(); status via flip_reset_status().

# ── Net-edge-after-cost entry gate (default OFF) ──────────────────────────────
# The system is accuracy-positive but P&L-negative (pays too much for favourites).
# When ON, an ENTRY is actionable only if its net edge (cents, after costs) clears
# the minimum — otherwise the pick is treated as NO-ENTRY. Default OFF (frozen
# champion). Validate before enabling on the live money path.
# Q15_V95_NET_EDGE_GATE_ENABLED=false
# Q15_V95_NET_EDGE_GATE_MIN_CENTS=0.0

# ── Rank picks by skill instead of net-edge (default OFF) ─────────────────────
# On the live record the confidence GRADE tracks accuracy (7M A 94% / D 54%)
# while net-edge rank order does not. When ON, #1/#2/#3 order by decision
# priority, then grade, then the model's decisiveness, then net edge. Default OFF.
# Q15_V95_RANK_BY_SKILL=false

# ── Entry-timing experiment (observational; default ON for collection) ────────
# Records what the model WOULD predict at extra time-to-close marks (seconds) so
# the optimal entry time is MEASURED, not guessed. Never delivered, never an
# official record; isolated table, graded on settlement; surfaced in the hourly
# report and timing_experiment_scoreboard(). Empty value disables collection.
# Q15_V95_TIMING_EXPERIMENT_SECONDS=780,720,660   # 13/12/11 min left (default)
# Q15_V95_TIMING_EXPERIMENT_BAND_SECONDS=6        # capture half-window per mark

# ── Flip-risk monitoring (default ON; read-only overlay) ──────────────────────
# Watches whether the FROZEN prediction is at risk of flipping (YES<->NO). It
# never changes the prediction. Three separate values: a 0-100 manipulation/flip
# RISK score (missing data lowers CONFIDENCE, never the score), a learned flip
# PROBABILITY (historical flip rate of the score's bucket), and a learned
# THRESHOLD (per checkpoint/direction/asset, with a >=30-sample gate -> overall
# fallback). HIGH FLIP RISK Telegram alerts are DORMANT until a learned threshold
# exists (require-learned ON); CONFIRMED PREDICTION FLIP notices send regardless.
# Q15_V95_FLIP_RISK_TRACKING=false           # disable the whole overlay
# Q15_V95_FLIP_ALERTS_ENABLED=false          # disable HIGH FLIP RISK Telegram sends
# Q15_V95_FLIP_ALERTS_REQUIRE_LEARNED=false  # allow alerts on overall (preliminary) thresholds
# Q15_V95_FLIP_CONFIRMED_ALERTS=false        # disable CONFIRMED PREDICTION FLIP notices
# Q15_V95_FLIP_MIN_SAMPLES=30                # per-asset learned-threshold sample gate
# Q15_V95_FLIP_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD=80          # conservative fallback threshold (never loosened)
# Q15_V95_FLIP_TARGET_RATE=0.40              # bucket flip-rate that defines "high risk"
# Q15_V95_FLIP_PERSISTENCE=3                 # consecutive observations required before an alert
# Q15_V95_FLIP_MIN_CATEGORIES=2              # independent evidence categories required (a wick alone won't alert)
# Q15_V95_FLIP_MIN_PROBABILITY=0.0           # minimum estimated flip probability (point estimate) to alert
# Q15_V95_FLIP_MIN_CONFIDENCE=40             # minimum risk confidence to alert
# Q15_V95_FLIP_ALERT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=90     # min seconds between warnings per asset/contract
# Q15_V95_FLIP_HYSTERESIS_POINTS=10          # reset only once score falls this far below threshold
# Q15_V95_FLIP_REARM_POINTS=15               # re-alert if score jumps this much after the last one
# Hit-rate reliability gate (default ON): a flip warning is DORMANT until the
# learned flip-rate for the current risk bucket is reliably high — its 95% Wilson
# LOWER bound must clear the minimum, so with few samples (a wide CI) it stays
# quiet no matter how high the point estimate. This is the "don't push flips until
# it has learned enough to be ~70%+ likely right" gate.
# Q15_V95_FLIP_REQUIRE_HITRATE=false         # disable the Wilson hit-rate gate
# Q15_V95_FLIP_MIN_HITRATE=0.70              # required Wilson lower-bound flip hit-rate to alert

# ── One active prediction per timeframe (default ON) ──────────────────────────
# The main 15M/10M/7M checkpoint alerts are capped at one ACTIVE pushed prediction
# per time frame: once an entry is recommended and delivered, that contract holds
# the timeframe's slot until it closes, so a second prediction for the same time
# frame is never pushed while one is live. Pushed predictions are tracked in a
# record kept SEPARATE from the full background observation record (the scoreboard
# reports both; background never inflates pushed accuracy).
# Q15_V95_ONE_ACTIVE_PER_TIMEFRAME=false     # disable the one-active-per-timeframe slot lock

# ── Production calibration (default ON) ───────────────────────────────────────
# Apply the ledger's regularized Platt calibration to the model probability that
# drives alerts. Auto-inactive until enough resolved rows exist to fit a
# calibrator (so it is a no-op on a freshly reset scoreboard), then applies the
# clamped fit. Set false to publish raw (identity) probabilities.
# Q15_V95_PRODUCTION_CALIBRATION_ENABLED=false
#
# OOS SELF-SELECTING calibration (DEFAULT ON, safe-by-construction). Splits the
# resolved rows chronologically (older train / newer test), measures the held-out
# Brier of identity vs Platt vs isotonic, and APPLIES the best method only if it
# beats identity by the floor — otherwise identity. So enabling calibration can
# only help or no-op out of sample, never silently ship a worse transform. This is
# the validated "turn calibration on" path; calibration_experiment() exposes the
# per-checkpoint Brier numbers for the review. Set false for the legacy behaviour.
# Q15_V95_CALIBRATION_OOS_SELECT=true
# Q15_V95_CALIBRATION_OOS_FLOOR=0.0005          # min held-out Brier gain to switch off identity
# Q15_V95_CALIBRATION_OOS_TEST_FRACTION=0.30    # chronological held-out test fraction
#
# Platt solver robustness. The slope CEILING was 1.50 — too low for an
# under-confident model (it wants slope ~2 to map 0.78 -> 0.95), so the Newton step
# pinned at the clamp and reported "unconverged" forever -> identity. Widened, and
# convergence is now judged on the APPLIED (post-clamp) step so a constrained
# optimum counts as converged. Raised the iteration budget too.
# Q15_V95_CALIBRATION_MAX_ITERS=50
# Q15_V95_CALIBRATION_SLOPE_MIN=0.40
# Q15_V95_CALIBRATION_SLOPE_MAX=3.00
# Q15_V95_CALIBRATION_INTERCEPT_CAP=1.50
#
# Isotonic as the unconverged-Platt fallback. DEFAULT ON now (was off): when Platt
# can't converge, use the isotonic curve (no convergence needed) instead of
# shipping identity. Only consulted when OOS-select is off or unavailable.
# (Q15_V95_CALIBRATION_ISOTONIC forces isotonic always, bypassing OOS-select.)
# Q15_V95_CALIBRATION_ISOTONIC_FALLBACK=true

# ── Champion edge / entry-gate levers ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Adverse-selection cost adder (cents), DEFAULT 0.0 (no live change). The base cost
# model assumes a fill at ask with half-spread slippage and omits adverse
# selection; the shadow-economics A/B measures the ~1c gap. Set this once that
# delta proves out, to stop the edge over-admitting thin-margin favourites.
# Q15_V95_EDGE_ADVERSE_SELECTION_CENTS=0.0
# Volatility-aware edge bar (DEFAULT OFF). Scale the required edge up for
# extreme-conviction (favourite) picks: required_edge *= 1 + k*(2*conservative-1)^2.
# At conservative=0.5 the factor is 1.0 (no change). Favourites need a thicker
# cushion because they are hit hardest by slippage/adverse selection.
# Q15_V95_EDGE_VOLATILITY_SCALING=false
# Q15_V95_EDGE_VOLATILITY_K=1.0
# NOTE: the 15M minimum-probability default was raised 0.58 -> 0.60 (15M is a coin
# flip on the record; 0.58 admitted near-random picks). Override with
# Q15_V95_15M_MIN_PROBABILITY.

# ── Public market-data circuit breaker (per asset) ────────────────────────────
# After THRESHOLD consecutive all-source failures, stop scheduling that asset's
# public feeds for COOLDOWN seconds (retry less during an outage; the snapshot
# still serves last-good/unavailable). Recovers on the next success. Surfaced as
# health()["breaker_open_assets"]. THRESHOLD=0 disables. Defaults: 5 / 30s.
# Q15_V95_PUBLIC_BREAKER_THRESHOLD=5
# Q15_V95_PUBLIC_BREAKER_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=30

# ── App refresh autostart ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Spawn the ~1s refresh loop on import (default). Set =0 to import the app for
# tests / offline diagnostics without starting the live cycle.
# Q15_AUTOSTART_REFRESH=0

# ── Scalp (short-term bounce) engine (default OFF) ────────────────────────────
# The scalp engine is disabled by default — the monitor focuses on the
# 15M/10M/7M checkpoint predictions. Set SCALP_ENABLED=true to re-enable scalp
# evaluation, alerts, and its record in the hourly report.
# SCALP_ENABLED=true

# ── Between-checkpoint DIP alert ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Q15_DIP_ALERT_ENABLED=true
# Q15_DIP_ALERT_MIN_EDGE_CENTS=6.0
# Q15_DIP_ALERT_REARM_EDGE_CENTS=2.0
# Q15_DIP_ALERT_MIN_WIN_PROBABILITY=0.55
# Q15_DIP_ALERT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS=90
# Q15_DIP_ALERT_MAX_PER_CYCLE=3
# Q15_DIP_ALERT_MIN_SECONDS_REMAINING=60

# ── Alert verbosity (optional) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Q15_ALERT_LEVEL=balanced      # balanced (default): deliver only actionable
#                               #   alerts, mute routine NO ENTRY YET / WATCH
#                               #   checkpoint reports.
#                               # all (or off/none/full/verbose/everything):
#                               #   deliver everything.
# Per-checkpoint overrides of Q15_ALERT_LEVEL. Unset -> inherit the global level
# above (default behaviour unchanged). Set e.g. to "all" to always receive that
# checkpoint's check even when it says NO ENTRY YET.
# Q15_ALERT_LEVEL_10M=all       # deliver every 10-minute check
# Q15_ALERT_LEVEL_7M=all        # deliver every 7-minute check
# Q15_ALERT_LEVEL_15M=          # (optional) override the 15-minute check
# Q15_FOCUS_TELEGRAM=           # comma-separated tickers to restrict alerts

# ── V7 diagnostics (optional, observational only) ─────────────────────────────
# Q15_V7_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED=true
# Q15_V7_SHADOW_CHALLENGER=true
# Q15_V7_DIAGNOSTIC_JOURNAL=true
# Q15_V7_DIAGNOSTIC_JOURNAL_PATH=data/q15_v7_diagnostic_events.jsonl

# ── Data-freshness tuning (optional; honest staleness on the price you trade) ──
# When the spot feed serves a bounded last-good fallback it re-stamps ts=now for
# candle continuity; default ON, this makes the V5 freshness gate judge the TRUE
# age (original_ts) so a stale underlying fails closed instead of reading fresh.
# Q15_V5_GATE_STALE_SPOT=true
# Public-composite price freshness decay: freshness = exp(-(age-grace)/tau).
# (tau is an e-folding time constant, NOT a half-life.)
# Q15_V95_PUBLIC_PRICE_GRACE_SECONDS=5
# Q15_V95_PUBLIC_PRICE_DECAY_SECONDS=30
# Abandon a fetch hung longer than this so in-flight tracking can't grow unbounded.
# Q15_FETCH_INFLIGHT_TTL_S=60

# ── Challenger Shadow vs Your System (read-only comparison; never trades) ──
# The shadow records a paired prediction beside the champion, grades only the
# locked pre-close prediction after settlement, and emits the per-window
# "CHALLENGER SHADOW vs YOUR SYSTEM" report (3 ranked picks per 15M/10M/7M, an
# end-result call, and all-time per-rank/per-interval records). Default-OFF.
# Q15_CHALLENGER_ENABLED=true
# model_version doubles as the reset key: bumping it starts the visible
# comparison fresh while old rows stay archived (PRE-RESET) in the same file.
# Q15_CHALLENGER_MODEL_VERSION=challenger-v5
# Optional explicit reset instant (epoch seconds, UTC) shown as "Comparison
# reset: …"; unset = stamped the first time this model_version records.
# Q15_CHALLENGER_RESET_AT=0
# Whether Your System (native) is graded only on picks delivered to Telegram before
# close, or on every prediction it generates. Default OFF = graded on generated
# predictions, like the Shadow, so the comparison is apples-to-apples and fills every
# window regardless of delivery health (delivery health is shown separately on the
# "Your System delivery:" audit line). ON = legacy delivery-gated rule (Yours goes
# empty whenever delivery fails). Reversible.
# Q15_CHALLENGER_NATIVE_SENT_ONLY=false

# ── Polymarket Up/Down Shadow (read-only second venue; never trades) ──────────
# A SEPARATE shadow for Polymarket's 15-minute crypto Up/Down markets ("close >=
# window-open price", resolved by Chainlink) — a DIFFERENT contract from our Kalshi
# strike markets, so it is graded against Polymarket's OWN result and kept entirely
# separate (never matched/merged with the Kalshi record). At 15M/10M/7M it freezes
# the SAME snapshot the champion used, emits OUR P(up) (the champion's structural
# model re-thresholded at the open price), records Polymarket's executable book, and
# after close grades both our model and the market. All HTTP/DB work runs on the
# shadow's own background worker — the live loop never blocks. Default-OFF.
# Q15_POLYMARKET_ENABLED=true
# Assets to attempt (Polymarket runs 15m crypto only for a subset; others show
# "NO MATCHING MARKET"):
# Q15_POLYMARKET_ASSETS=BTC,ETH,SOL
# model_version doubles as the reset key (old rows archived, never mixed in):
# Q15_POLYMARKET_MODEL_VERSION=polymarket-v1
# Q15_POLYMARKET_RESET_AT=0
# Q15_POLYMARKET_REPORT=true                  # emit the compact POLYMARKET SHADOW card
# Read-only public endpoints + per-request timeout (seconds) + reconcile cadence:
# Q15_POLYMARKET_CLOB_URL=https://clob.polymarket.com
# Q15_POLYMARKET_GAMMA_URL=https://gamma-api.polymarket.com
# Q15_POLYMARKET_HTTP_TIMEOUT=5.0
# Q15_POLYMARKET_RECONCILE_EVERY=60.0

# ── Official interval report: 3 ranked picks + one-report-per-interval lock ──
# The official 15M/10M/7M report carries the top-3 ranked picks (every field the
# system calculates) and is locked once delivered — no duplicate/recheck/resend
# for that interval+window. Default ON; OFF falls back to the single-pick compact
# panel.
# Q15_V95_RANKED_PANEL=true
# The official per-interval report (the 'TOP 3 PICKS' ranked 15M/10M/7M check) is
# always delivered — even on a NO-ENTRY interval — so the owner sees every check
# and the visible record / Challenger-Shadow-vs-Yours comparison fill (Your System
# counts only DELIVERED predictions). Default ON. Set to false to fall back to the
# old behaviour where a NO-ENTRY official report is muted under the balanced level.
# Q15_V95_RANKED_REPORT_ALWAYS_DELIVER=true
# Backstop dedup: refuse to send the SAME interval's official report twice within
# this many seconds, regardless of the window key (guards against an unstable
# window key from a contract-mapping flip near a 15-min boundary, or a restart
# re-fire). Legitimate same-interval reports are ~900s apart, so keep this < 900.
# Default 600. (NOTE: this cannot dedup across SEPARATE bot instances/containers —
# two processes with the same Telegram token each send their own reports.)
# Q15_V95_REPORT_MIN_GAP_SECONDS=600
# Cents of net edge that map to a full edge component in the 0-100 shadow ENTRY
# SCORE (read-only overlay; does NOT drive the frozen-champion entry decision).
# Q15_V95_ENTRY_SCORE_EDGE_CAP=10
# Cross-asset / correlated-movement SHADOW factors (x_market_momentum,
# x_rel_strength, x_div_from_leader, ...): recorded per official prediction in an
# ISOLATED ledger column for the read-only factor lab (scripts/stats.py) to grade.
# Never touch feature_json / the frozen champion / a live decision. Default ON;
# this flag is a pure rollback switch for the recording.
# Q15_V95_SHADOW_FACTORS_ENABLED=true

# Experimental shadow signals (q15_upgrade/shadow_signals.py): six extra signals
# (order-flow persistence, book resiliency, prediction stability, return-entropy,
# regime-transition, coin-flip fade) computed from already-collected data, recorded
# next to each prediction and graded by a continuous out-of-sample A/B (hourly
# report's "Experimental signals" block + /api/q15-v9-5/shadow-signals). Read-only;
# never feeds the frozen champion or the live probability. Collection default ON.
# Q15_V95_SHADOW_SIGNALS_ENABLED=false
# Q15_V95_SHADOW_SIGNALS_MIN_ROWS=40          # min settled rows before grading a signal
# Q15_V95_SHADOW_SIGNALS_TRAIN_FRACTION=0.70  # time-ordered train fraction (rest is the OOS test)
# Q15_V95_SHADOW_SIGNALS_BRIER_FLOOR=0.0005   # min OOS Brier reduction to count as a lift
# Q15_V95_SHADOW_SIGNALS_ALPHA=0.05           # paired t-test significance for a promotion candidate
# Q15_V95_SHADOW_SIGNALS_RECENT_CANDLES=24    # candle lookback for the signal computations

# Near-coin-flip over-confidence guard (q15_upgrade/checkpoint_v95.py,
# _coinflip_confidence_shrink). The settled record shows calibrated P(YES) in
# ~[0.50,0.60) realises YES only ~27% of the time (over-confident) while P(YES) >=
# 0.60 is well calibrated. When STRENGTH > 0 this pulls the probability toward 0.5
# ONLY inside +/-BAND of 0.5, clamped so it NEVER crosses 0.5 — so the predicted
# side never changes (every previously-correct pick keeps its win/loss) and only
# the calibration/Brier improves. DEFAULT OFF (strength 0.0); promote after the
# shadow A/B `coinflip_fade` confirms the lift out of sample.
# Q15_V95_COINFLIP_SHRINK_STRENGTH=0.0        # 0 = off; up to 1.0 = full shrink to 0.5 at the flip
# Q15_V95_COINFLIP_SHRINK_BAND=0.10           # half-width in P(YES) space around 0.5 that is faded

# ── Learning-snapshot export (tools/learning_export.py) ───────────────────────
# Hourly background worker (started by .replit alongside the app + GitHub Relay)
# that force-pushes the live learning ledgers to a DEDICATED branch so a review
# session can `git fetch origin learning-snapshots` and audit the system against
# real data. Read-only wrt the ledgers; reuses the relay's GH_PUSH_TOKEN /
# GITHUB_TOKEN (Contents: Read+Write). Pushes to a side branch ONLY — never main
# — so it can't conflict with the relay or stall a deploy. All defaults shown.
# LEARNING_EXPORT_BRANCH=learning-snapshots   # target branch (refuses main/master/HEAD)
# LEARNING_EXPORT_INTERVAL=3600               # seconds between pushes (min 60)
# LEARNING_EXPORT_DATA_DIR=data               # dir scanned for *.sqlite3 ledgers
# LEARNING_EXPORT_REPO=turneraontez-alt/tez   # owner/repo (falls back to GITHUB_RELAY_REPO)

# ── Ultoim Build (q15_upgrade/ultoim/) — SEPARATE read-only research system ────
# A completely independent research overlay: its own DB, model version, counters,
# reset marker, and Telegram channel. Never trades, never touches the live
# system's predictions/records/feed. Reuses the champion's frozen per-asset
# analysis to publish 3 VALUE-ranked final-outcome picks at 12M/10M/7M with a
# multi-factor A/B/C grade + active-research flip/stability estimate. Default ON
# (read-only collector) but stays MUTED until the chat id below is set, so it
# silently accrues data without delivering or touching the live system. Set
# Q15_ULTOIM_ENABLED=false for a fully inert, byte-identical app. Uses the
# order-flow-persistence / book-resiliency features (Q15_V95_SHADOW_SIGNALS_ENABLED,
# already default ON) for the grade + flip ensemble.
# Q15_ULTOIM_ENABLED=true             # DEFAULT ON (read-only research)
# Q15_ULTOIM_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID=        # separate channel; reuses TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN. Unset ⇒ records but does not deliver
# Q15_ULTOIM_DB=data/q15_ultoim_v1.sqlite3
# Q15_ULTOIM_MODEL_VERSION=ultoim-build-v1
# Q15_ULTOIM_MARK_BAND_SECONDS=90     # fire a report when seconds-left first enters [mark-band, mark]
# Q15_ULTOIM_RECONCILE_EVERY_SECONDS=30
# Q15_ULTOIM_EDGE_WEIGHT=0.15         # value-ranking: rank = quality + edge_weight*clamp(net_edge/edge_scale)
# Q15_ULTOIM_EDGE_SCALE_CENTS=10
# Q15_ULTOIM_GRADE_A_MIN=0.60         # multi-factor quality cutoffs (A/B; below B is C)
# Q15_ULTOIM_GRADE_B_MIN=0.50         # recalibrated to the weighted-average scorer (was 0.48, unreachable)
# Grade = weighted AVERAGE of positive signals (not a product), so a strong setup
# lands high instead of being multiplied toward zero. Weights need not sum to 1.
# Q15_ULTOIM_GRADE_W_CONFIDENCE=0.50  # calibrated chosen-side probability (dominant term)
# Q15_ULTOIM_GRADE_W_DATA=0.15
# Q15_ULTOIM_GRADE_W_EVIDENCE=0.15
# Q15_ULTOIM_GRADE_W_AGREEMENT=0.20
# Q15_ULTOIM_GRADE_INCLUDES_CHALLENGER=false  # keep the unvalidated challenger out of the agreement term
# Q15_ULTOIM_MANIP_GRADE_PENALTY=0.85 # bounded multiplicative penalty when manipulation is suspected
# Q15_ULTOIM_FLIP_GRADE_WEIGHT=0.20   # how much the (unvalidated) flip estimate lowers a grade — kept low
# Q15_ULTOIM_FLIP_DECISION_THRESHOLD=0.55

# ── Ultoim V2 (q15_upgrade/ultoim_v2/) — SEPARATE read-only PAPER entry-alert ──
# A separate, DEFAULT-OFF, read-only paper entry-alert research system. Own DB,
# model version, reset marker, and Telegram channel. NEVER trades and never
# touches the live system's predictions/records/feed. With Q15_ULTOIM_V2_ENABLED
# unset the app is byte-identical (no DB/worker/channel). When enabled, it emits a
# single paper "BEST ENTRY" card per qualifying contract per window (NO-only
# delivery, gated on confidence/ask-band/net-edge) and learns from settled results.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_ENABLED=false           # DEFAULT OFF (must be set true to run)
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID=       # separate channel; reuses TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN. Unset ⇒ records, never delivers
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_DB=data/q15_ultoim_v2_v1.sqlite3
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_MODEL_VERSION=ultoim-v2
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_MIN_CONF=0.55           # entry gate: selected-side probability floor
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_ASK_LO=50.0             # entry gate: ask band (cents), inclusive
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_ASK_HI=72.0
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_MIN_EDGE=2.0            # entry gate: conservative net edge after costs (cents), inclusive
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_NO_ONLY=true            # NO-only DELIVERY (YES never delivers); see RESEARCH_YES below
# --- OWNER-ENABLED LIVE CONFIG (the 4 knobs below DEFAULT ON; set to the revert value to undo). ---
# --- Basis is ONE in-sample day — treat as a live experiment; re-grade on multi-day v2 data. ---
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_NO_EDGE_WAIVE=true       # DEFAULT ON. Waives the edge gate (gate_c) for NO: the stated edge is INVERSE,
#                                        # so edge>=min cut the cheapest, highest reward:risk NO WINNERS (~+$35/bet; gate-pass
#                                        # NO book ~+$1.8k→~+$4.1k at $100/bet, 1 day). Conf floor + ask band still apply;
#                                        # min_edge / best-entry price untouched. Set =false to restore the edge gate.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_SKIP_15M=true            # DEFAULT ON. Fire only at 10M/7M (drop the weak, -EV-on-all-7-assets 15M bin).
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_SKIP_7M=false            # DEFAULT OFF. true ⇒ drop 7M ENTRIES too (no screen/alert/trade), run 10M-only.
#                                        # 7M is ~break-even on the live sample (all-time ~+36c n=62; one -137c day). Exit
#                                        # warnings on already-open positions are unaffected. Reversible (set false).
#                                        # 10M/7M unchanged; the frozen champion already disables its own 15M alerts. =false to restore 15M.
# --- Net-improvement levers (workflow-verified; owner-enabled LIVE by default, all reversible). See HANDOFF.md.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_CAP_7M_ASK=true          # DEFAULT ON (owner-enabled). At the 7M mark, do NOT admit a NO whose ask > CAP_7M_ASK_MAX.
#                                        # Delivered v2 book: 7M asks >72c are live net-NEGATIVE (-57c/21 bets, -2.7c/bet) vs +26c/bet
#                                        # for <=72c; that slice both-halves sign-flips. Suppresses delivery AND research for the over-
#                                        # cap 7M NO; 10M / YES untouched. The one delivered-money-backed net lever. =false to uncap.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_CAP_7M_ASK_MAX=72        # ask ceiling (cents) the 7M cap enforces.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_ENABLE_12M=true          # DEFAULT ON (owner-enabled). 12M DELIVERS live alerts: cheaper/earlier entries than 10M for a
#                                        # similar in-sample win (12M@60-69 ~91%, both-halves 93/89) => better reward:risk for a selective
#                                        # 1-pick-per-window trader (redundancy is moot when you take ONE entry). CAVEAT: ~1 in-sample day.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_ENABLE_11M=true          # DEFAULT ON (owner-enabled) but RECORD-ONLY (11M is in research_only_intervals): the redundant
#                                        # middle between 12M and 10M, so it accrues gradeable data without a 3rd near-duplicate alert.
#                                        # 13M is deliberately excluded (fragile: both-halves win% 82%->65%). =false to disable a mark.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_DELIVER_TOP_N=1          # DEFAULT 1 (owner-enabled, SELECTIVE). Single best by reward:risk per (mark, window). With marks
#                                        # 12M/10M/7M firing + per-CONTRACT dedup, this keeps it to ~1-2 distinct alerts/window and
#                                        # concentrates on the best pick (settled: ~+13c/bet vs ~+11c taking all, fewer fees). >1 to widen.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_DELIVER_BY_RR=true       # DEFAULT ON. Pick by CHEAPEST ask (best reward:risk / payoff per $) not highest net-edge
#                                        # — the higher-EV NO selection; 7M-weighted (7M asks run cheaper). =false ⇒ pick by net-edge.
# --- CONVICTION rules (owner-enabled, DEFAULT ON). Keyed on how many assets co-trigger a NO in the SAME
# 15-min window this cycle (count of would-fire entries — known at bet time, no look-ahead). From the settled
# alert ledger: 12M loses money unless >=3 co-trigger; 10M with >=3 co-triggers ran materially better (~86%).
# NOTE: the 10M doubling is leverage on the COUNT, not on correctness — it doubles a losing window too. Thin
# (~3-day) evidence; staked paper P&L (hypothetical_pnl_cents) is scored at the size taken so it tracks live.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_SKIP_12M_UNLESS_MIN=true # DEFAULT ON. Skip 12M delivery unless >=MIN_TRIGGERS_12M co-trigger;
#                                        # below that the 12M picks are recorded as research (graded, never alerted/fired).
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_MIN_TRIGGERS_12M=3       # DEFAULT 3. Min co-triggering 12M NOs in a window to deliver 12M at all.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_DOUBLE_10M_ON_MIN=true   # DEFAULT ON. Size up (stake x DOUBLE_STAKE) on 10M when >=MIN_TRIGGERS_10M co-trigger.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_MIN_TRIGGERS_10M=3       # DEFAULT 3. Min co-triggering 10M NOs in a window to double the stake.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_DOUBLE_STAKE=2           # DEFAULT 2. Bet size taken on a conviction-doubled 10M entry (scales staked P&L).
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_RECORD_XFLOW=false      # DEFAULT OFF. true ⇒ record the broad-market cross-asset flow (x_market_flow)
#                                       # on each row for measure-first validation of a possible NO-side veto. NEVER read by the gate.
# --- 15M selective-entry research SCREEN (record-only; see fifteen_min.py). Scoped to 15M-NO rows ---
# Stamps, on every 15M NO row, whether a SELECTIVE gate WOULD fire (s15_pass = LUKEWARM & CHEAP) plus two
# orthogonal tilt codes (CAL_DRIFT / FRESH). RECORD-ONLY: never gates fire/delivery, never affects 10M/7M.
# Defaults from a five-agent study of the settled ledgers (single-session fit — must clear validate.py's
# promotion bar on the cross-session record before it could ever gate). All tunable; none read by the gate.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_S15_SEL_MAX=0.55        # LUKEWARM: selected_probability strictly < this (confident 15M NO loses)
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_S15_ASK_LO=47.0         # CHEAP: ask band [lo, hi) in cents (expensive NOs ≥60 are money-losing)
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_S15_ASK_HI=60.0
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_S15_CAL_DRIFT_MAX=-0.03 # CAL_DRIFT tilt: (calibrated_yes − raw_yes) ≤ this (recalibration leaning NO)
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_S15_FRESH_MIN_SEC=875.0 # FRESH tilt: seconds_remaining ≥ this (a fresh 15M quote, not a late snapshot)
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_DISTANCE_PIN_SIGMA=0.15  # record-only: NO rows with |distance_sigma|<this are the NEAR-strike "pin"
#                                        # (would-abstain) bucket the recap measures vs FAR. distance_sigma is the one
#                                        # shadow feature shown to transport (near=loss, far=win). NEVER gates delivery.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_DISTANCE_GATE=true       # DEFAULT-ON (owner-enabled). ABSTAINS (paper) on 15M NEAR-strike NO entries
#                                        # (|distance_sigma|<DISTANCE_PIN_SIGMA above) — suppresses delivery only; measurement
#                                        # is unchanged. 10M/7M and YES unaffected. Read-only, never places/cancels an order.
#                                        # Set =false to opt out (byte-identical no-gate). Basis: replicates on v95 (n=186);
#                                        # payoff-asymmetry edge, not yet p<0.05 on delivered 15M (n=8).
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_EXPENSIVE_NO=true        # DEFAULT-ON (owner-enabled). ADMITS a NON-15M NO whose ask is in
#                                        # (ASK_HI, EXPENSIVE_NO_ASK_HI] even with sub-min stated edge — lifts the ceiling
#                                        # AND waives the edge gate for that band only (confidence floor + ask_lo still apply;
#                                        # 15M / YES untouched). Basis: for NO the stated edge is INVERSE; the band wins ~84%
#                                        # cross-ledger (n=893, v1+v95+v2), net-positive after the expensive losses. Read-only.
#                                        # Set =false to opt out (byte-identical plain band).
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_EXPENSIVE_NO_ASK_HI=85.0 # extended NO ceiling for the band above. Held at 85: the (85,100] slice is
#                                        # net-negative (thin max-profit lets the rare loss dominate), so do NOT raise to 100.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_FLOW_AGAINST_NO=0.6      # record-only: a NO bet against strong buy-side flow (champion_flow>=this) is the
#                                        # loss zone — the fix that lifted P&L ~50% OOS on the v95 NO side. The recap
#                                        # measures would-abstain (flow>=thr) vs keep, + the v2-native regime proxy. NEVER gates.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_MARK_BAND_SECONDS=90    # fire when seconds-left first enters [mark-band, mark]
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_RECONCILE_EVERY_SECONDS=30
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_RECAP_SECONDS=1800      # research-recap cadence
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_MAX_STALE=8.0           # refuse to ALERT on a staler spot than this (records a STALE_FEED abstain)
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_MIN_SCOREBOARD_N=30     # print-floor: suppress the headline % below this resolved-N
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_MIN_PROMOTE_N=50        # PROMOTION bar (distinct from the print-floor): below this the verdict
#                                       # reads INSUFFICIENT. n=30 prints a number but cannot separate ~80-85%
#                                       # from the ~75% base NO rate; promotion also needs Wilson-low > base rate.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_RESEARCH_YES=true       # record the best YES candidate per window as a RESEARCH-ONLY row (never
#                                       # delivered) so YES-prone windows finally produce gradeable data — the
#                                       # precondition the system needs to be promotable. =false to disable.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_HICONV_YES=true          # RECORD-ONLY. Stamp reason code HICONV_YES on a RESEARCH_YES row when it
#                                        # clears the only profitable YES sliver the live 10M data found (17/20=85%):
#                                        # cal_yes>=CAL_MIN AND market-implied-YES>=MARKET_MIN (don't fight the market)
#                                        # AND THRESHOLD_PIN. Builds a clean out-of-sample YES record before any YES
#                                        # delivery is considered. NEVER delivers/trades (YES stays NO-only). =false off.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_HICONV_YES_CAL_MIN=0.70  # V2 calibrated-YES floor for the HICONV_YES marker.
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_HICONV_YES_MARKET_MIN=0.60  # market-implied-YES floor (market agreement) for the HICONV_YES marker.
# Defensive-exit / flip warning: fires in chat ONLY when (A) a paper entry was suggested earlier in the
# window AND (B) at/after the 7M mark the model has FLIPPED to the opposite side, decisively AND sustained
# (anti-spike). Records + grades every warning (learns whether bailing was right and how much it recovered).
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_EXIT_WARNINGS=true      # default ON when the overlay is enabled
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_EXIT_WATCH_SECONDS=420  # start watching for the flip from this many seconds left (7M)
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_EXIT_CONFIRM_CYCLES=3   # anti-spike: opposite call must hold this many consecutive observations
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_EXIT_CONFIRM_SECONDS=20 # ...AND span at least this many seconds before firing
# Q15_ULTOIM_V2_EXIT_MIN_FLIP_CONF=0.55 # ...AND the flipped side must be at least this confident (not a 0.51 wobble)
# Blowup-risk SHADOW screen (screen.py): NO env knob by design. It stamps conf_gap/blowup_risk
# on every recorded row and reports AUC in the recap, but is RECORD-ONLY — it never gates fire,
# sizing, or delivery (it failed an OOS stress test and did not transport; see HANDOFF.md). It
# cannot be turned into a live filter without a code change + clearing validate.py's promotion bar.
# Pin-break SHADOW features (runner.py): NO env knob by design. Records pin_break_drift
# (structural z_score — drift through the strike) and threshold_interaction (champion's scalar
# threshold feature; AUC ~0.70 on the v95 ledger) on every row, RECORD-ONLY — never gate a
# decision. They target the strike-pin losses that distance_sigma/conf_gap can't; validate before use.

# ============================================================================
# ULTOIM V2 EXECUTOR — OPT-IN LIVE ORDER LAYER (q15_upgrade/executor/).
# DEFAULT-OFF + DRY-RUN-by-default. v2 stays read-only; this is the ONLY code that
# can place a real Kalshi order, and only with ALL of: ENABLED=true, DRY_RUN=false,
# valid keys (KALSHI_API_KEY_ID + KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY), and KILL unset. Safe ramp:
#   1) ENABLED=true, DRY_RUN=true  -> logs the order it WOULD place (no money)
#   2) verify the logged orders for a few days, then DRY_RUN=false at tiny size
#   3) scale to the configured 4%/pick only after fills match the paper assumptions.
# Q15_EXEC_ENABLED=false            # master switch. unset/false = executor never loads.
# Q15_EXEC_DRY_RUN=true             # true (default) = log would-be orders, send NOTHING.
# Q15_EXEC_KILL=false               # PANIC BUTTON. true = block ALL placement (entries+exits).
# Q15_EXEC_BANKROLL_CENTS=0         # sizing base in CENTS. 0 = read live Kalshi balance (live only).
# Q15_EXEC_PER_PICK_PCT=0.04        # 4% of bankroll per pick (owner rule). 2 picks/window = ~8%.
# Q15_EXEC_MAX_PICKS_PER_WINDOW=2   # cap picks per settlement window.
# Q15_EXEC_MAX_PER_WINDOW_PCT=0.08  # HARD cap on total stake per window (correlation guard; ~76% co-settle).
# Q15_EXEC_DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT_PCT=0.20# circuit breaker: stop NEW entries once down 20% on the day.
# Q15_EXEC_MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS=6     # cap concurrent open positions.
# Q15_EXEC_MAX_STAKE_PER_PICK_CENTS=5000  # HARD $-cap per trade (cents). Default $50: no single
#                                   # contract order risks more, regardless of bankroll/%. 0 = no cap.
#                                   # ABSOLUTE: NOT scaled by the conviction multiplier — set it to the
#                                   # intended doubled size (e.g. 30000=$300) so the conviction extra fits.
# Q15_EXEC_CONVICTION_SIZING=true   # DEFAULT ON. When a v2 pick carries stake_multiplier>1 (a >=3-co-trigger
#                                   # 10M window), double the 2nd-or-later pick of that window; the LEAD pick
#                                   # of every window always stays at the base stake ("first $150, extras
#                                   # double"). The per-pick cap above still binds. =false ⇒ every pick flat.
# Q15_EXEC_MIN_PRICE_CENTS=50       # refuse orders priced outside [50,85] (defence vs a bad signal).
# Q15_EXEC_MAX_PRICE_CENTS=85
# Q15_EXEC_LIMIT_OFFSET_CENTS=0     # limit at ask+offset. 0=pay ask; negative=try cheaper (may not fill).
```

### `.github/workflows/tests.yml`

```yaml
name: tests

# Automatic proof the deployed code is sane: run the full suite on every push to
# main and on every PR. A green check = main is safe to deploy.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  pytest:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install test dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          # Install the declared runtime deps (requests, flask, websockets,
          # cryptography, psycopg2-binary, tzdata) so the app-level test modules
          # import cleanly instead of erroring on collection. requirements.txt is
          # the single source of truth, so adding a runtime dep there can never
          # silently break CI again. cffi is cryptography's build/runtime helper.
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest cffi

      - name: Show build_info
        run: cat build_info.json || echo "(no build_info.json)"

      - name: Run test suite
        run: python -m pytest tests/ -q
```

Q15_ULTOIM_V2_NO_ONLY = "false"
Q15_ULTOIM_V2_BTC_CONFIRM = "true"
Q15_ULTOIM_V2_BTC_CONFIRM_MARGIN_YES = "0.10"  # C5: asymmetric YES cutoff (BTC>=0.60)
Q15_ULTOIM_V2_REQUIRE_INVERSE_EDGE = "true"

# Reversible: set false to revert 12M to research-only.
Q15_ULTOIM_V2_DELIVER_12M = "false"   # 10M-ONLY book: 12M no longer delivers (reverted)
Q15_EXEC_DRY_RUN = "true"

# folded into this uniform base. Hard per-pick ceiling raised to $300 (30000c) so the conviction
# upsize can land. CONVICTION DOUBLING (Q15_EXEC_CONVICTION_SIZING, default on): in a window where
# 3+ assets co-trigger a NO at 10M, the LEAD pick stays $150 and the 2nd-or-later pick doubles to
# $300 ("first 150, extras double") — so a 2-pick conviction window commits up to $450. Leverage on
# thin (~3-day) data; NO daily circuit breaker is set, so per-trade size is the main risk control.
# Revert: FLAT_STAKE_CENTS=7500 (or 0 for % sizing) and/or CONVICTION_SIZING=false.
Q15_EXEC_FLAT_STAKE_CENTS = "15000"
Q15_EXEC_MAX_STAKE_PER_PICK_CENTS = "30000"
Q15_EXEC_CONVICTION_SIZING = "true"
# FILL RELIABILITY: limit at the ask + 1c (still clamped to the 50-85c band) so a fast tick-up
# doesn't leave the order resting unfilled. Costs at most 1c/contract; converts "missed/rested"
# into "filled" on a marketable NO buy. Owner-approved. 0 = pay exactly the ask. Set to 0 to revert.
Q15_EXEC_LIMIT_OFFSET_CENTS = "1"

# 2nd pick must have ask>=60c (the proven expensive-NO band; sub-60 is the cheap-NO loss zone). Data:
# 2nd pick +8.9c/bet overall, +10.7c/bet at ask>=60 (n=41). Cap is 2 (3rd pick is -EV). NOTE: this
# ~doubles per-window variance (same-window picks co-settle ~79-89%; worst all-lost 2-pick 10M window
# = -$200); the per-window budget self-caps at ~$200 and the daily stop is OFF (owner's choice). Revert
# by setting MAX_PICKS back to 1.
Q15_EXEC_MAX_PICKS_PER_WINDOW = "2"
Q15_EXEC_SECOND_PICK_MIN_ASK = "60"
# BTC CROSS-ASSET GATE — owner LIVE (default ON in code; pinned here for visibility + kill switch).
# Suppresses an alt-NO entry when BTC is contemporaneously bullish (lean>=0.50) OR the complex is
# risk-on (prior-window breadth>=0.50) — the regime where alt-NO fails because the alts co-move up
# with BTC. EXEMPTS >=3-co-trigger 10M conviction windows (those run ~100% and are protected by the
# defensive exit). Backtest (in-sample ~2.6 days): lifted kept-book accuracy 78->90% and trimmed the
# BTC-up co-settling losers. ⚠️ in-sample/thin data — watch it across regimes. KILL SWITCH: set
# Q15_EXEC_BTC_GATE="false" to disable instantly. Thresholds: Q15_EXEC_BTC_GATE_LEAN / _BREADTH.
Q15_EXEC_BTC_GATE = "true"

# ask>=59c. Closes the cheap-NO loss zone: on the fuller fired-NO sample the whole 55-58c band is
# net-negative (55c 17%/-230c, 57c 0%/-114c; 55-58 combined ~-282c over n=14) while 59c+ is the clean
# 84% / +1541c plateau. 59 keeps the 59c winners (n small, +41c) and the entire 60c+ plateau while
# cutting 55-58. The old 55 floor let the worst single cent (55c, -230c) straight through. Protects the
# 10M stake first (10M at ask<58 was -7c/pick). 0 = no floor. Reversible. (Raised 55->59 per owner.)
Q15_EXEC_MIN_ENTRY_ASK = "59"
# DAILY STOP OFF (owner-chosen): both limits 0 -> no daily loss circuit breaker, and the per-order

Q15_EXEC_DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT_CENTS = "0"
Q15_EXEC_DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT_PCT = "0"
Q15_EXEC_YES_ENABLED = "true"
Q15_EXEC_YES_DRY_RUN = "true"
